backup_reference.vendor_config_note: The V55 kuavo.json selects linker_hand on both sides. The old initialization profile in the snapshot still identifies V53/Revo1 and is not a V55 deployment profile.
backup_reference.interface_note: The backed-up library maps six-channel BrainCo-compatible commands to Linker in send_position and inversely maps thumb feedback in DexhandRosNode::publish_loop. Use 0..100 at ROS level; no second mapping in this project.
backup_reference.device_note: HandProtocolType.ini is proto_can. Device entries retain revo1_hand labels; those labels do not override EndEffectorType and do not authorize the Revo1 CAN current tool.
backup_reference.model_note: The exact Linker product SKU is not established by the six-channel compatibility interface.

backup_configuration.status: Static backup facts; not live commissioning approval.
backup_configuration.upper_version_note: Upper .bashrc still exports 53; lower .bashrc and vendor V55 configuration establish V55/Linker. Correct the stale upper environment during deployment.
backup_configuration.vendor_pose_note: Manufacturer nominal poses do not define this project side/folded/chest_high targets or arms-down acceptance bounds.
backup_configuration.camera_topic_note: cameras.topics describes the project-managed camera launch namespaces. The vendor camera service uses the namespaces listed here; do not run both camera owners on the same devices.
backup_configuration.camera_rotation_note: Profile rotations 180/0/0 and head_driver_rotation=180 remain project defaults; backup camera launch does not establish consistency with the selected training images.
backup_configuration.workstation_note: 192.168.3.115 is the original workstation management address, not evidence of its robot-facing inference IP. network.workstation_ip remains unset.
backup_configuration.deployment_path_note: vendor_workspace and upper_workspace exist in the backup; lower_root contains initialize only. upper_root is the intended project deployment path and was absent in the snapshot.
backup_configuration.sdk_gesture_note: dexhand_base.h generic SDK gestures are open=[60,0,0,0,0,0], close=[50,50,50,50,50,50]. They are not evidence of Linker ROS-mapped initial targets or task-specific finger_caps.
